scope: Actual CLI reports and gates plus every decoded observation from the selected installed reader, compared with native MLflow 3.17.1 SDK histories. Authored logging controls, no training or production reliability claim.

findings.title: Diverged (did not recover)
findings.message: train/loss ended at 10 after reaching 0.3704 around step 17. It has been above that level since step 20 and the log ends with 1788% of the run's progress given back.
fixes: Use a checkpoint from around step 17, before the rise.
Lower the learning rate or restart from the last good checkpoint before this window.
Check the LR schedule isn't re-warming up unintentionally (see lr_schedule detector).
Look for a data distribution shift at this step range (new shard, curriculum stage change).
